## Status

## Installation

To install from Bioconductor, use the following code:

    # if needed, install BiocManager
    install.packages("BiocManager")

    # install GEOquery
    BiocManager::install("GEOquery")

To install directly from github:

    BiocManager::install('seandavi/GEOquery')

## Usage

See the full vignette in
[rmarkdown](https://github.com/seandavi/GEOquery/blob/master/vignettes/GEOquery.Rmd)
or visit Bioconductor for details:

- [Release
  version](http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/GEOquery.md)
- [Devel
  version](http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/html/GEOquery.md)

## How to contribute

Contributions to GEOquery development can be submitted as a [pull
request](https://github.com/seandavi/GEOquery/pulls) or a [feature
request issue](https://github.com/seandavi/GEOquery/issues). We
recommend following the [Bioconductor coding
standards](https://contributions.bioconductor.org/r-code.html) where
possible.

  : Get Supplemental Files from GEO
- [`getGEOfile()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/getGEOfile.md)
  : Download a file from GEO soft file to the local machine
- [`getGSEDataTables()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/getGSEDataTables.md)
  : Get GSE data tables from GEO into R data structures.
- [`getRNASeqData()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/getRNASeqData.md)
  : Get GEO RNA-seq quantifications as a SummarizedExperiment object
- [`getRNASeqQuantGenomeInfo()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/getRNASeqQuantGenomeInfo.md)
  : Extract genome build and species for GEO RNA-seq quantification
- [`hasRNASeqQuantifications()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/hasRNASeqQuantifications.md)
  : Does a GEO accession have RNA-seq quantifications?
- [`parseGEO()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/parseGEO.md)
  : Parse GEO text
- [`searchFieldsGEO()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/searchFieldsGEO.md)
  : Provide a list of possible search fields for GEO search
- [`searchGEO()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/searchGEO.md)
  : Search GEO database
- [`urlForAccession()`](http://seandavi.github.io/GEOquery/reference/urlForAccession.md)
  : The URL for a GEO accession
